description: Pinned toolchain versions for IoT.Edu. Paths are resolved from environment variables, never from a developer home directory.

esp-idf.hostNote: This Phase 0 host installs ESP-IDF with Espressif EIM. IDF export.sh expects python_env/idf5.4_py3.10_env, which is absent. Use IDF_ACTIVATE pointing at activate_idf_v5.4.1.sh. A second checkout of v5.4.4 exists on the host and must not be used.

esp-matter.note: Revision observed on the Phase 0 host checkout. Original archive metadata recorded ESP_MATTER_PATH usage but not a git hash.
